name: Historic Centre of Siena
description: Siena is a Tuscan hill city in central Italy whose brick-red medieval streets still look much as they did when it rivalled Florence. Its Gothic centre fans out from the shell-shaped Piazza del Campo, where the Palio horse race is run twice a year. Visitors can also see the work of Duccio, Simone Martini and the Lorenzetti brothers, painters who shaped European art.
